Hezbollah-aligned Lebanese speaker says any deal with Israel ‘will not pass’. An annex reportedly preserves IDF freedom of action in the security zone.
  • Airspace & logistics: Multiple regional airports closed (Iran; later Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Flight scans showed ~795–812 aircraft in the area this window; several military aircraft detected.
  • Diplomacy: Qatar slated to host talks. Iran canceled technical talks; Pakistan reported as a mediator (ongoing context).
  • Civilians: Continued Israeli strikes in Gaza; displaced families report worsening conditions.
  • Quick tactical note: Tunnel demolition and destruction of underground facilities aim to reduce Hezbollah’s ability to conduct cross-border attacks but will likely prompt continued reprisal strikes.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF successfully demolished a major terror tunnel; US officials report a temporary halt to strikes pending talks.
Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of renewed strikes and reprisal attacks in next 72 hours.
